topic: The lighthouse keeper's last log entry — written after he officially died
hook: His final log was written after he officially died.
script: His final log was written after he officially died. The Eilean Mòr lighthouse in Scotland was found abandoned in 1900. Three keepers had vanished. The final log entry described a storm of unimaginable force — on a day when weather records showed perfectly calm seas. One entry read: 'God is over all.' The lighthouse clock had stopped. The meal on the table was untouched. No bodies. No explanation. Ever. Follow for real mysteries the world has never solved.
